sources.summary: The British actor on no-nonsense women, learning her lines in the bath and encountering a ‘nation of beautiful people’ while filming a new medical drama in Australia You’re starring in Australian medical drama The F Ward. What was the best medical fact you learned on set? Some of the operations I studied and watched in order to emulate them, I couldn’t believe that the patient was alive. Half of their body was outside of them; that should be inside! Continue reading...
